patterns.note: Extensive use of full-bleed, high-resolution photography as background elements for major sections, often with a dark overlay for text contrast.
Alternating dark (deep blue/black) and light (white/light grey) background sections to visually segment content blocks and create clear hierarchy.
Full-bleed background images in key sections exhibit a subtle parallax or fixed-position effect, creating a layered depth as foreground content scrolls over them.
Content sections are revealed with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.
A high-contrast palette of deep dark blues/blacks and crisp whites, accented by a vibrant red for branding and key calls to action.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations to enhance the user experience. As the user scrolls, new content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect. Large, full-bleed background images are either fixed in place or implement a gentle parallax, creating a sense of depth as foreground elements scroll past. The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility. This motion system likely leverages a JavaScript library for scroll observation and animation control, potentially using canvas for more complex visual effects if present, though the observed motion is primarily CSS-driven reveals and background effects.

Content is presented in distinct, full-width sections that alternate between dark and light backgrounds. Text is often placed directly over full-bleed images, utilizing a semi-transparent dark overlay to ensure high contrast and readability.

Calls to action are typically presented as rectangular buttons with subtle rounded corners, using either a white background with dark text or a dark background with white text, providing clear visual hierarchy and inviting interaction.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold headings (~3-4x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller uppercase labels for categories or sub-headings.
design_tokens.radius: subtle; buttons and cards have a slight corner radius, while most images and section edges are sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between major sections, with comfortable padding within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, high-quality automotive photography as integral background elements, combined with subtle scroll-triggered depth effects, creates an immersive and premium visual experience. This approach elevates the product presentation beyond a typical marketing site, making the vehicles the undeniable focal point.
